points.point1: Developed Plainly in collaboration with OpenAI Codex, combining my product direction with AI-assisted development across the frontend, backend, and deployment.
points.point2: Built a full-stack productivity PWA using React, TypeScript, and Vite, with a Node.js API on Vercel Functions and MongoDB for data persistence.

points.point2: Designed a declarative API around components such as VerticalStack and HorizontalStack, reducing layout composition complexity.
points.point3: Built the package to be reusable and consistent, adopting it as the foundational layout system across multiple personal projects.
points.point4: Authored clear documentation and design decisions to support adoption, maintenance, and ongoing iteration.

points.point1: Developed a REST API using Go, Chi, and MariaDB for school administration, covering students, classes, subjects, teachers, staff, and user accounts.
points.point2: Structured the backend into four layers, with domain-defined interfaces and clear separation between business logic, HTTP transport, and data persistence.
points.point3: Implemented JWT authentication, account activation and recovery, Argon2id password hashing, role-based access control (RBAC), and rate limiting on sensitive endpoints.
points.point4: Built transactional bulk operations for student management, ensuring atomicity and data consistency across imports, updates, and deletions.
points.point5: Standardized JSON responses, pagination, and input validation, while documenting API endpoints and contracts using OpenAPI 3.0.
